newsitem.title: USA: AT&T NCR unit back in profit in Q3.
newsitem.headline: AT&T NCR unit back in profit in Q3.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Thursday its computing unit NCR Corp returned to an operating profit of $29 million in the third quarter from a year-ago $196 million loss. The year ago excludes $1.6 billion of restructuring charges.
Quarterly revenues fell 18 percent to $1.66 billion. Year to date operating earnings were $3 million versus a $587 million loss a year ago.

NCR orders overall were lower because of discontinued business lines but for core businesses showed good gains over the year-ago quarter and in year-to-date comparisons, AT&T said without giving figures.

AT&T is spinning off NCR to shareholders at the end of the year. It bought the company for $7.5 billion in stock 1991, but it has on balance lost money since. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
